questions.question_english: We can apply ________ OLAP operation on scales data summarized by quarter to see the data summarized by month.
questions.technical_proof: Drill Down OLAP Operation: Used when we want to see data at a MORE detailed level. Going from Quarter (higher/less detailed level) to Month (lower/more detailed level) is DRILL DOWN. Roll-Up is the opposite (Month → Quarter = less detail). Slice = select one value on one dimension. Pivot = rotate the data axis. Quarter → Month = More detail = Drill Down.
questions.explanation: Drill Down (OLAP Operation): Drill Down का उपयोग तब किया जाता है जब हम डेटा को अधिक विस्तार (detailed level) पर देखना चाहते हैं। उदाहरण: यदि डेटा Quarter (तिमाही) के अनुसार summarized है, और हम उसे Month (महीने) के अनुसार देखना चाहते हैं, तो हम Drill Down ऑपरेशन लागू करते हैं। Quarter → Month = More detail = Drill Down।
questions.trap_point: Quarter → Month = MORE detail = DRILL DOWN. Month → Quarter = LESS detail = ROLL UP. Always remember: Drill Down = Go deeper (more detail).
questions.memory_trick: DRILL DOWN = Dig deeper = More detail. Quarter has 3 months → drilling down shows each month separately.
questions.revision_fact: Drill Down: Quarter → Month (going to MORE detailed level). Roll Up: Month → Quarter (going to LESS detailed level).

questions.subtopic: NOT a Major Feature of Data Warehouse
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा डेटा वेयरहाउस की प्रमुख विशेषता नहीं है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT a major feature of a data warehouse?
questions.technical_proof: Inmon's four major features of a Data Warehouse: 1) Subject-Oriented, 2) Integrated, 3) Non-Volatile, 4) Time-Variant. 'Distributed' is NOT one of Inmon's defining features of a data warehouse. In fact, a traditional data warehouse is typically CENTRALIZED (single site), not distributed. Data warehouses are centralized repositories.
questions.explanation: डेटा वेयरहाउस की प्रमुख विशेषताएं (Inmon के अनुसार): 1.Subject-Oriented (विषय-आधारित) — डेटा व्यापार के विषयों (जैसे ग्राहक, बिक्री) के अनुसार संगठित होता है। 2.Time-Variant (समय-परिवर्ती) — डेटा का ऐतिहासिक दृष्टिकोण होता है। 3.Non-Volatile (गैर-वोलेटाइल) — एक बार डेटा लोड हो गया, तो वह बदला नहीं जाता (read-only)। 4.Integrated (एकीकृत) — विभिन्न स्रोतों से आए डेटा को एकीकृत किया जाता है। 'Distributed' इनमें से नहीं है।
questions.trap_point: 'Distributed' sounds like a good database property, but it is NOT one of Inmon's four DW characteristics. DW is typically CENTRALIZED.
questions.memory_trick: DW = SINT: Subject-oriented, Integrated, Non-volatile, Time-variant. NO Distributed in SINT.
questions.revision_fact: 'Distributed' is NOT a feature of data warehouse; Inmon's four features are Subject-Oriented, Integrated, Non-Volatile, Time-Variant.

questions.question_hindi: मल्टी-डायमेंशनल डेटा मॉडल में, क्यूबॉइड जो समराइजेशन के निम्नतम स्तर को रखता है, उसे __________ क्यूबॉइड कहा जाता है।
questions.question_english: In multi-dimensional data model, the cuboid that holds the lowest level of summarization is called the __________ cuboid.
questions.technical_proof: In a multi-dimensional data model (Data Cube), the cuboid that holds the LOWEST level of summarization (most detailed data, no aggregation) is called the Base Cuboid. It contains raw or detailed data. The APEX cuboid (top of the lattice) holds the HIGHEST level of summarization (most aggregated). Base Cuboid = Most detailed (least summarized). Apex Cuboid = Least detailed (most summarized).
questions.explanation: Base Cuboid: मल्टी-डायमेंशनल डेटा मॉडल में, जब हम सभी डायमेंशन्स पर सबसे डिटेल स्तर का डेटा रखते हैं, तो उसे Base Cuboid कहा जाता है। यह वह स्तर होता है जहाँ कोई भी summarization नहीं होती — यानी raw or detailed data। Apex Cuboid = सबसे ऊपर = सबसे ज़्यादा summarized (सबसे कम detail)।
questions.trap_point: BASE = Lowest summarization = MOST DETAILED. APEX = Highest summarization = LEAST DETAILED. These are opposite concepts.
questions.memory_trick: BASE of building = Ground level = Most BASIC/DETAILED data. APEX = Top = Most SUMMARIZED.
questions.revision_fact: Base cuboid = lowest level of summarization (most detailed). Apex cuboid = highest level of summarization (most aggregated).

questions.question_hindi: स्टार स्कीमा डेटा मॉडल में, डेटा वेयरहाउस में एक बड़ी सेंट्रल टेबल होती है, जिसे __________ टेबल कहा जाता है।
questions.question_english: In star schema data model, the data warehouse contains a large central table, which is called __________ table.
questions.technical_proof: In Star Schema: The FACT TABLE is the large central table that stores quantitative measures (e.g., sales amount, quantity, revenue). It is surrounded by DIMENSION tables that provide context (time, product, customer, location). The Fact table has foreign keys linking to all dimension tables, forming the 'star' shape.
questions.explanation: Star Schema में: एक बड़ी सेंट्रल टेबल होती है, जिसे Fact Table कहा जाता है। यह टेबल quantitative data (जैसे sales amount, quantity) को स्टोर करती है। इसके चारों ओर Dimension Tables होती हैं जो context (जैसे समय, स्थान, उत्पाद) देती हैं। इसलिए स्टार स्कीमा में डेटा वेयरहाउस की मुख्य टेबल — Fact Table।
questions.trap_point: Dimension tables are surrounding tables, not the central table. The CENTRAL large table in Star Schema is always the FACT table.
questions.memory_trick: STAR = One CENTRAL star (Fact Table) surrounded by satellite stars (Dimension Tables).
questions.revision_fact: In Star Schema, the large central table is the FACT TABLE storing quantitative measures.

questions.subtopic: NOT a Valid Data Model for Data Warehouse
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा डेटा वेयरहाउस के लिए एक मान्य डेटा मॉडल नहीं है?
questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT a valid data model for data warehouse?

options.text: Fact constellation schema / फैक्ट कांस्टेलेशन स्कीमा

questions.technical_proof: Valid data models for data warehouse: 1) Star Schema (central fact table + surrounding dimension tables). 2) Snowflake Schema (normalized version of star schema). 3) Fact Constellation Schema (multiple fact tables sharing dimension tables, also called Galaxy Schema). Entity-Relationship (ER) Schema is used for OLTP/transactional database design, NOT for data warehouse design. ER models capture relationships between entities for operational databases, while data warehouses use dimensional modeling.
questions.explanation: डेटा वेयरहाउस में उपयोग होने वाले मान्य डेटा मॉडल: 1.Star Schema — Central fact table + surrounding dimension tables। 2.Snowflake Schema — Normalized version of star schema। 3.Fact Constellation Schema — Multiple fact tables sharing dimension tables (also called galaxy schema)। Entity-Relationship (ER) Schema — यह OLTP/transactional database design के लिए उपयोग होता है, डेटा वेयरहाउस के लिए नहीं।
questions.trap_point: ER Schema is for OLTP (operational) databases. Data warehouses use Star, Snowflake, or Fact Constellation schema. Never ER for DW.
questions.memory_trick: DW Models: Star + Snowflake + Galaxy/Constellation. ER = Entity-Relationship = OLTP design = NOT for DW.
questions.revision_fact: ER Schema is NOT a valid DW model. Valid DW models: Star, Snowflake, Fact Constellation (Galaxy) schema.
